_meta.dev.emem/mutation: server-side materialisation only: fills this responder's cache from upstreams it already registered. No caller content is stored, so nothing can be planted through it.

dev.emem/observed_latency.note: measured here over recent calls, not a budget

annotations.title: Ask a free-text question about a place

cell.description: cell64 string (alternative to `place`, use when you have one from a prior emem_locate / emem_recall response). Provide this OR `place` OR `lat`+`lng`.

include.description: Opt-in REST envelope sections. `reasoning` drops `algorithms_for_question`; add `algorithms` to keep it. The MCP projection ignores these.

include_image.description: Bundle a Sentinel-2 RGB scene URL for the resolved cell. Adds ~1-2 s on first call.

model.description: Optional. Compose an EXTRA prose answer with a named model, returned as `model_answer` beside the deterministic `answer`. It does not replace it: `answer` is synthesised from the structured fields and never calls a model, so every number in it traces to a fact_cid, and asking for a model must not turn a checkable answer into an unchecked one. `model_answer` carries provenance.class = model_output. Name it by base_model (`nvidia/Cosmos3-Edge`), by family (`cosmos3_edge`, `gemma`), or by any fragment naming exactly one of them (`cosmos`); a fragment matching several is refused and names them; an unroutable name is refused with the list of routable ones, and a routable model whose service is not answering is refused as busy or down rather than silently substituted. Cosmos is refused while its host has no GPU.

place.description: Free-text place name (e.g. "Mount Fuji", "Ashok Nagar, Ranchi"). REQUIRED unless `cell` or `lat`+`lng` is provided. Extract the noun phrase from the user's turn; the responder geocodes via OSM Nominatim.

q.description: User's natural-language question about the place (e.g. "is this neighbourhood flood-prone").

verbose.description: REST only: true adds per-algorithm formulas, band metadata and long prose. The MCP projection is small (about 7 KB) either way; the REST envelope is larger.

name: emem_ask

answer.description: The prose answer. Also in the content block, which carries the MCP projection; POST /v1/ask has the full envelope.

cell.description: The cell64 the question resolved to: emem's address for the place.

spatial_trace.description: A spatial memory trace: what this responder has measured at this place, as primitives a model can reason over rather than a picture a person looks at.

absent.description: Bands this responder looked for and did not find. Absence is evidence: without it a consumer infers coverage nobody measured.

at.description: [lat, lng] of the cell, so a point has a position without a second call.

counts.description: Totals taken BEFORE any cap, so truncation can be seen rather than guessed.

layers.description: Points grouped by what kind of evidence they are: surface (what the ground is), built (what stands on it), now (what is happening there), embedding (vectors for similarity). A layer absent from this list means the question never reached that kind of evidence; a band looked for and not found is in `absent` instead.

age_s.description: How old the reading was when this answer was written.

class.description: Provenance class: direct_sensor, deterministic_index, estimator, model_output, attested_execution, human_curated, unclassified. What KIND of claim this is.

f.description: Index into `receipt.fact_cids` (or the list `_projection.fact_cids_at` names). Dereference it for the signed bytes.

value.description: The measured value, in the band's own units. `null` where the band was looked for and not found: an absence is a reading.

stage.description: Which stage of the answer grounded these readings.
